# groups

Print the current process group names on Linux.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/groups
```

<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Reads process credentials from Linux procfs. Names must resolve from the first configured local files source in /etc/nsswitch.conf. External directory lookups and named operands are unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
